settings.text:
We ship within the United States. Orders over $50 ship free; under $50, a flat rate is shown at checkout before you pay.

Orders placed before 2pm ET ship the same business day. After that, the next business day.
As soon as your order leaves our facility, we email you a tracking link. No account required.

If gear doesn't hold up to normal driving life, send it back within 14 days for a refund. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

To start a return, reply to your order confirmation email or contact support@slipstreamgear.com.
Once we receive your return, refunds are issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
If something arrives damaged or incorrect, email us within 7 days and we'll make it right.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.lede: Straight answers on how we ship and how returns work. No fine-print games.
